sections.content: Use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional to discuss possible changes and their consequences.

items.spanish: Si cambiara la sociedad, tendríamos que adaptarnos.
items.english: If society changed, we would have to adapt.

items.spanish: Si hubiera menos recursos, habría más problemas.
items.english: If there were fewer resources, there would be more problems.

items.spanish: Si la tecnología cambiara más rápido, tendríamos que aprender más deprisa.
items.english: If technology changed faster, we would have to learn more quickly.
